sources.title: FoodMap v0.1 food-component annotations
sources.quality_note: Legacy curated baseline. Individual annotations retain evidence_type and notes but are not all externally cited.

sources.title: MFDS Food Nutrient Database
sources.quality_note: Use for Korean nutrient values and official food-code links; record the downloaded release and retrieval date per import.

sources.title: FoodOn: A farm to fork ontology
sources.quality_note: Use for ontology categories, ingredients, processes, and cross-domain identifiers; it is not a substitute for Korean nutrient values.

sources.citation: Gardiner C, et al. The effect of caffeine on subsequent sleep: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Sleep Medicine Reviews. 2023;69:101764.
sources.quality_note: Supports direction and timing scope for the synthetic late-caffeine sleep prior, not a personalized clinical estimate.

sources.citation: Zeevi D, et al. Personalized Nutrition by Prediction of Glycemic Responses. Cell. 2015;163(5):1079-1094.
sources.quality_note: Supports individual variability in postprandial glucose responses; FoodMap uses it only with CGM-compatible outcomes.

sources.citation: The Effects of Sodium Reduction and the DASH Diet on Ambulatory Blood Pressure. 2026.
sources.quality_note: Supports the direction of the synthetic sodium-blood-pressure prior; a valid blood-pressure measurement is required.

sources.title: FoodMap v0.3 synthetic FoodMap generator
sources.quality_note: Produces synthetic pipeline-validation records only; generated response scores are not clinical measurements.
